blocks.title: Privacy
blocks.lead: What teleionlabs.com, Tessera and Tessera's model shim keep, and for how long. Updated November 2, 2026.

blocks.heading: This site
paragraphs: teleionlabs.com has no accounts, no cookies, no analytics scripts and no ads, and it stores nothing in your browser.
The live status on the home and status pages is read by our server, so your browser talks only to teleionlabs.com.
Cloudflare runs the site. It keeps the site's request logs (the address asked for, the answer and related details) for up to 7 days. We use them only to find and fix problems.

blocks.heading: Tessera without an account
paragraphs: A free session gets its own practice space. What it saves, and the record of what it did, are deleted after 24 hours.

To keep free use fair, Tessera counts requests by network address and by the name of the software making them. Its records keep each as a keyed one-way value that changes every day, not the address or the name itself.

blocks.heading: Tessera's model shim
paragraphs: The free preview calls no model and saves nothing.

blocks.heading: Eranos
paragraphs: Requests on Eranos are public: anyone can read a request and its result. Eranos has its own [privacy page](https://eranosforgood.org/privacy).

blocks.heading: Private information
paragraphs: We don't accept private information at this stage. Please leave it out of Tasks, records, questions and requests.

blocks.heading: Questions
paragraphs: Write to hello@teleionlabs.com. For a security problem, write to security@teleionlabs.com.
